articles.title: Severe Flooding Hits the Four Corners Region
articles.summary: Heavy rain has flooded parts of four western states, forcing evacuations, while officials warn more rain may come through Sunday.

articles.title: Alaska Senate Fight Centers on Two Candidates Named Dan Sullivan
articles.summary: Trump says he ordered a lawsuit that could block certification if the Republican incumbent loses, a move an election expert calls unprecedented.

articles.title: U.S. Proposes Tighter Rules on High-Tech Investments Abroad
articles.summary: Treasury has proposed wider limits on U.S. high-tech investments in countries of concern, but the rule is not final yet.
